text_en: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
text_cn: 苍天，倾听，我要发言；大地，聆听我口要说的话！

text_en: May my teaching drop like the rain, my speech condense like the dew; like gentle rain on grass, like showers on new growth.
text_cn: 愿我的教训如雨下降，我的言语似露滴落，像降在绿茵上的细雨，像落在青草上的甘霖！

text_en: For I will proclaim the name of the Lord ; ascribe greatness to our God!
text_cn: 因为我要宣扬上主的名，请赞颂我们的天主！

text_en: The Rock, his work is perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God, without deceit, just and upright is he;
text_cn: 他是磐石，他的作为完美无比；他的行径公平正直，他是忠实无妄的天主，公义而又正直。

text_en: yet his degenerate children have dealt falsely with him, a perverse and crooked generation.
text_cn: 那不堪称为子女的，自趋堕落，背叛了他，实在是个邪恶败坏的世代！

text_en: Do you thus repay the Lord , O foolish and senseless people? Is not he your father, who created you, who made you and established you?
text_cn: 愚昧无知的人民，你们就这样报答上主吗？他不是生育你，创造你，使你生存的大父吗？

text_en: Remember the days of old, consider the years long past; ask your father, and he will inform you; your elders, and they will tell you.
text_cn: 你回想往古的时日，思念历代的岁月；问你的父亲，问你的长辈，他必给你讲述：

text_en: When the Most High apportioned the nations, when he divided humankind, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the gods;
text_cn: 当至高者为民族分配产业时，分布人的子孙时，按照天使的数目，为万民划定了疆界；

text_en: the Lord ’s own portion was his people, Jacob his allotted share.
text_cn: 但雅各伯是上主所保留的一分，以色列成为他特有的产业。

text_en: He sustained him in a desert land, in a howling wilderness waste; he shielded him, cared for him, guarded him as the apple of his eye.
text_cn: 上主在旷野之地，在野兽咆哮的原野，发现了他，遂将他抱起，加以抚育，加以保护，有如自己的眼珠。

text_en: As an eagle stirs up its nest, and hovers over its young; as it spreads its wings, takes them up, and bears them aloft on its pinions,
text_cn: 老鹰怎样守候自己的窝巢，飞翔在幼雏之上，上主也怎样伸展双翅，把他背在自己的翼上。

text_en: the Lord alone guided him; no foreign god was with him.
text_cn: 上主独自领导了他，他旁边并没有外邦的神祇。

text_en: He set him atop the heights of the land, and fed him with produce of the field; he nursed him with honey from the crags, with oil from flinty rock;
text_cn: 上主使他驰骋于高原之上，以田间的出产养育他，使他享受岩穴间的蜜，坚石中的油，

text_en: curds from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs and rams; Bashan bulls and goats, together with the choicest wheat— you drank fine wine from the blood of grapes.
text_cn: 牛酪和羊乳，肥美的羔羊和公羊，巴商的公牛与山羊，以及上等的麦面；并以葡萄美酒作你的饮品。

text_en: Jacob ate his fill; Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You grew fat, bloated, and gorged! He abandoned God who made him, and scoffed at the Rock of his salvation.
text_cn: 雅各伯吃肥了，耶叔戎吃胖了，会踢人了。──的确，你胖了，肥了，饱满了。──他遂抛弃了造他的天主，轻视了救他的磐石。

text_en: They made him jealous with strange gods, with abhorrent things they provoked him.
text_cn: 他们以邪神的敬礼激起他的妒火，以可憎恶的事物，惹他动怒；

text_en: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to deities they had never known, to new ones recently arrived, whom your ancestors had not feared.
text_cn: 他们所祭祀的是邪神，而非真神，是向来所不认识的神，是近来新兴，你们的祖先所不敬畏的神。

text_en: You were unmindful of the Rock that bore you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
text_cn: 你忽略了那生你的磐石，忘记了那使你出世的天主。

text_en: The Lord saw it, and was jealous; he spurned his sons and daughters.
text_cn: 上主一见，大为震怒，遂抛弃了自己的子女，

text_en: He said: I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children in whom there is no faithfulness.
text_cn: 说我要掩面不顾他们，要看他们的结局如何；这实在是败坏的一代，毫无信实的子女。

text_en: They made me jealous with what is no god, provoked me with their idols. So I will make them jealous with what is no people, provoke them with a foolish nation.
text_cn: 他们以虚妄之神，激起我的怒火，以虚无之物，惹我动怒；我也要以那不成子民的人激起他们的妒火，以愚昧的民族惹他们发怒。

text_en: For a fire is kindled by my anger, and burns to the depths of Sheol; it devours the earth and its increase, and sets on fire the foundations of the mountains.
text_cn: 我的怒火一燃起，必烧到阴府的深底，吞灭大地及其出产，焚毁山岳的基础。

text_en: I will heap disasters upon them, spend my arrows against them:
text_cn: 我要将灾祸不断加在他们身上，向他们射尽我的箭矢。

text_en: wasting hunger, burning consumption, bitter pestilence. The teeth of beasts I will send against them, with venom of things crawling in the dust.
text_cn: 他们必因饥饿而衰弱，必为热症、毒疫所消灭；我还使尖牙的野兽和土中爬行的毒虫伤害他们。

text_en: In the street the sword shall bereave, and in the chambers terror, for young man and woman alike, nursing child and old gray head.
text_cn: 外有刀剑，内有恐怖，使少男少女，乳儿白头，同归于尽。

text_en: I thought to scatter them and blot out the memory of them from humankind;
text_cn: 我原想粉碎他们，将他们的记念由人间消灭；

text_en: but I feared provocation by the enemy, for their adversaries might misunderstand and say, “Our hand is triumphant; it was not the Lord who did all this. ”
text_cn: 但我怕仇人自夸，怕敌人误会说：“是我的手得胜了，而不是上主行了这一切。”

text_en: They are a nation void of sense; there is no understanding in them.
text_cn: 他们原是无谋的民族，没有一点见识。

text_en: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would discern what the end would be.
text_cn: 如果他们有点智慧，定会明了此事，看清未来的局势。

text_en: How could one have routed a thousand, and two put a myriad to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, the Lord had given them up?
text_cn: “若不是他们的磐石出卖了他们，上主放弃了他们，一人怎能追击一千，两人怎能打跑一万？”

text_en: Indeed their rock is not like our Rock; our enemies are fools.
text_cn: 连我们的仇人也承认，他们的磐石不如我们的磐石。

text_en: Their vine comes from the vinestock of Sodom, from the vineyards of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison, their clusters are bitter;
text_cn: 诚然，他们的葡萄秧，出自索多玛的葡萄园，来自哈摩辣的田园；他们的葡萄是毒葡萄，粒粒葡萄皆酸苦。

text_en: their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
text_cn: 他们的酒是蛇的毒汁，是蝮蛇的猛烈毒液。

text_en: Is not this laid up in store with me, sealed up in my treasuries?
text_cn: 这事岂不是贮藏在我身旁，封闭在我府库里？

text_en: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, for the time when their foot shall slip; because the day of their calamity is at hand, their doom comes swiftly.
text_cn: 等到他们失足之时，我必复仇报复；他们灭亡的日子确已临近，给他们预定的命运就要来到。

text_en: Indeed the Lord will vindicate his people, have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, neither bond nor free remaining.
text_cn: 因为上主要卫护自己的人民，怜恤自己的仆人。当他看见他们的能力已逝，奴隶与自由人已到绝境，

text_en: Then he will say: Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
text_cn: 必问说：“他们的神祇在哪里，他们投靠的磐石究在何处？

text_en: who ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their libations? Let them rise up and help you, let them be your protection!
text_cn: 一向吃他们祭牲脂肪的，喝他们奠祭酒浆的，都在哪里？让他们起来援助你们罢！让他们做你们的保障罢！

text_en: See now that I, even I, am he; there is no god besides me. I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal; and no one can deliver from my hand.
text_cn: 现在你们应认清，只有我是‘那一位’，除我以外没有别神；我使人死，也使人活；我击伤人，也加以治疗；谁也不能由我手中救出。

text_en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and swear: As I live forever,
text_cn: 我向天举手宣誓：我生活，至于永远！

text_en: when I whet my flashing sword, and my hand takes hold on judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
text_cn: 我一磨亮我的刀剑，我一掌握裁判权，必向我的敌人雪恨，对恨我的人报复。

text_en: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh— with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the long-haired enemy.
text_cn: 我要使我的箭矢醉饮鲜血，使我的刀剑吞食血肉；阵亡和俘虏的鲜血，仇敌将领的头颅。”

text_en: Praise, O heavens, his people, worship him, all you gods! For he will avenge the blood of his children, and take vengeance on his adversaries; he will repay those who hate him, and cleanse the land for his people.
text_cn: 万国，你们应向他的百姓祝贺！因为上主必为自己的仆人报血仇，向仇敌报复，圣洁自己的土地和百姓。

text_en: Moses came and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: 梅瑟和农的儿子若苏厄前来，将这篇诗歌的话朗诵给百姓听。

text_en: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
text_cn: 梅瑟向全以色列人一朗诵完了，

text_en: he said to them: “Take to heart all the words that I am giving in witness against you today; give them as a command to your children, so that they may diligently observe all the words of this law.
text_cn: 就对他们说：“你们应把我今日警告你们的一切话记在心内，好吩咐你们的子孙，谨守遵行这法律上的一切话。

text_en: This is no trifling matter for you, but rather your very life; through it you may live long in the land that you are crossing over the Jordan to possess. ”
text_cn: 因为这为你们不是空洞的话，而是关系你们的生命；由于遵守这话，你们才能在过约但河后所要占领的地上，长久居留。”

text_en: On that very day the Lord addressed Moses as follows:
text_cn: 上主就在当天对梅瑟说：

text_en: “Ascend this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites for a possession;
text_cn: “你到摩阿布去，上这座阿巴陵山，即面对耶里哥的乃波山上去，观看我要给以色列子民作产业的客纳罕地。

text_en: you shall die there on the mountain that you ascend and shall be gathered to your kin, as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his kin;
text_cn: 你要死在你所上的山上，归到你本族那里，像你哥哥亚郎死在曷尔山，归到他本族那里一样。

text_en: because both of you broke faith with me among the Israelites at the waters of Meribath-kadesh in the wilderness of Zin, by failing to maintain my holiness among the Israelites.
text_cn: 因为你们在亲旷野，卡德士的默黎巴水边，在以色列子民中对我失信，没有在他们中尊我为圣；

text_en: Although you may view the land from a distance, you shall not enter it—the land that I am giving to the Israelites. ”
text_cn: 为此，我赐给以色列子民的地方，你只可由对面眺望，却不能进去。”
